@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+export function compact(lines: string[]): string[] {
+  const result: string[] = [];
+  for (const line of lines) {
+    if (line.startsWith("Progress:")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+    result.push(line);
+  }
+  return result;
+}
